_note: Generated from DCAT-AP-UK. Names match the metadata weaver, so records written by the weaver load into these definitions. Not tested against a live tenant. Add each to the table type with PUT /api/v1/metadata/types/{id}; propertyType names a field type such as string or markdown.

customProperties.name: title
customProperties.description: The name of the resource, in plain English.

customProperties.name: description
customProperties.description: A plain English account of what the resource contains and what it can be used for.

customProperties.name: identifier
customProperties.description: The main identifier of the resource in the publisher's own catalogue.

customProperties.name: publisher
customProperties.description: The organisation responsible for making the resource available.

customProperties.name: contactPoint
customProperties.description: Where to ask questions about the resource or give feedback on it.

customProperties.name: accessRights
customProperties.description: Who can get the data, and on what terms.

customProperties.name: securityClassification
customProperties.description: The classification under the Government Security Classifications Policy that the data itself carries.

customProperties.name: licence
customProperties.description: The licence under which the resource can be used.

customProperties.name: accrualPeriodicity
customProperties.description: How often the resource is updated.

customProperties.name: criticalDataAsset
customProperties.description: Whether the resource is a critical data asset under the Data Asset Management Policy.

customProperties.name: creator
customProperties.description: The organisation that created or compiled the content of the resource.

customProperties.name: created
customProperties.description: The date the content of the resource was created or compiled.

customProperties.name: conformsTo
customProperties.description: A standard, specification or schema the resource follows.

customProperties.name: temporal
customProperties.description: The period of time the data is about.

customProperties.name: personalData
customProperties.description: Whether the data contains information about identifiable living people, and in what form.

customProperties.name: rights
customProperties.description: A statement of any restriction on access or use, such as the data sharing agreement or legal gateway needed.

customProperties.name: modified
customProperties.description: The date the content of the resource last changed.

customProperties.name: issued
customProperties.description: The date the resource was first made available.

customProperties.name: abstract
customProperties.description: A one-sentence summary of the resource, of no more than 250 characters.

customProperties.name: theme
customProperties.description: The broad subject of the resource, from a controlled list.

customProperties.name: keyword
customProperties.description: Words or short phrases that people might search for, not already in the title or description.

customProperties.name: spatial
customProperties.description: The geographic area the data is about.

customProperties.name: distribution
customProperties.description: A form in which the data can be got, such as a file or an API.

customProperties.name: landingPage
customProperties.description: A web page where people can find out about the resource and how to get it.

customProperties.name: version
customProperties.description: The version of the resource.

customProperties.name: sensitiveData
customProperties.description: Whether the data contains information that needs extra care beyond being personal, such as special category data.

customProperties.name: qualifiedAttribution
customProperties.description: An organisation and the role it plays for the resource, such as data owner or data steward.

customProperties.name: language
customProperties.description: The language or languages of the resource.

customProperties.name: alternative
customProperties.description: Another name the resource is known by, such as an abbreviation or a former name.

customProperties.name: otherIdentifier
customProperties.description: Any other identifier the resource is known by, such as one in a national or sector register.

customProperties.name: inSeries
customProperties.description: The dataset series this dataset belongs to.

customProperties.name: isReplacedBy
customProperties.description: A newer resource that replaces this one.

customProperties.name: expires
customProperties.description: The date after which the resource should no longer be used.

customProperties.name: previousVersion
customProperties.description: The version this one replaces in a sequence.

customProperties.name: versionNotes
customProperties.description: What changed in this version.

customProperties.name: spatialResolutionInMeters
customProperties.description: The smallest distance the data can tell apart, in metres.

customProperties.name: temporalResolution
customProperties.description: The smallest period the data can tell apart, as an ISO 8601 duration.

customProperties.name: referenceData
customProperties.description: A code list, classification or set of groupings the data uses, such as age bands or a geography.

customProperties.name: qualityAnnotation
customProperties.description: A link to a published statement or measurement of the quality of the data.

customProperties.name: relation
customProperties.description: Another resource closely related to this one, such as the report the data supports.

customProperties.name: qualifiedRelation
customProperties.description: A related resource together with the kind of relationship.

customProperties.name: documentation
customProperties.description: A web page that documents the resource, such as a user guide or a methodology.

customProperties.name: metadataAudience
customProperties.description: Who is allowed to see the metadata record itself.

customProperties.name: applicableLegislation
customProperties.description: Legislation that requires, governs or permits the publication or sharing of the resource.

customProperties.name: hasPolicy
customProperties.description: A machine-readable policy, in the W3C Open Digital Rights Language (ODRL), saying what may and may not be done with the resource.

customProperties.name: jurisdiction
customProperties.displayName: Where the data is held or sent
customProperties.description: Every country or territory where the data is stored or processed, or to which it is sent.

customProperties.name: transferMechanism
customProperties.description: The basis under UK GDPR on which personal data in the resource may be sent outside the UK.

customProperties.name: missingValue
customProperties.description: A property this record leaves empty on purpose, and why.
